name: Neural field spirals and fragments
description: Neural field found by the class-4 search: strong coupling with a narrow inhibitory surround (kernel_sigma2 ≈ 1.4) and strong, slow adaptation. Seeds break into free-travelling fragments, which curl up into rotating spirals; the spirals compete and the largest slowly takes over the field. Things to try: the seed brush starts new activity; paint g lower to anchor a spiral; nudge kernel_sigma2 up toward 2 for more separate bumps, or tau_a down for faster turnover.
